subsegment: Utility-scale solar PV — single-axis tracker (50-250 MWac)
description: Greenfield PV plants on flat agricultural or desert land, with optional DC-coupled BESS scope. Fixed-price EPC with module supply often owner-furnished or carved out; schedule risk concentrated around tracker delivery and interconnection.

typical_risks.description_template: Module shipments may be detained under UFLPA enforcement at port of entry; release timelines from CBP are unpredictable and can delay mechanical completion.
Single tracker vendor {tracker_oem} supplies torque tubes, drives, and controls; any quality hold cascades across {n_blocks} blocks.
Placed-in-service must precede the IRA bonus credit step-down; substation backfeed dependency on utility is the critical schedule chain.
Pile driving across {n_acres} acres may encounter refusal in caliche or rock layers, requiring pre-drilling for a percentage of {pile_count} piles.
Concurrent regional solar build-out pressures journeyman electrician availability; ramp curve for DC and MV terminations at risk.
Site in {region} hail-alley exposes installed modules to in-construction hail damage; stow algorithm and insurance coverage gaps may be exposed.
Owner-furnished module substitution mid-construction triggers re-stamping of structural and electrical calculations and tracker re-configuration.

typical_issues.description_template: Container of modules held at port pending UFLPA documentation review; {n_mw} MW of installation deferred.
Pile refusal rate exceeded {pct}% in north sectors; pre-drill rig mobilised, productivity impact under quantification.
Central inverter firmware fails utility witness test; vendor field engineer dispatched.
QC found row-to-row alignment outside spec across {n_blocks} blocks; rework planned during low-wind windows.
Regional wildfire smoke reducing crew hours under company AQI policy.
Trencher damaged previously installed MV cable; repair and re-test ongoing.
DGA results on GSU transformer show elevated gases during energisation; vendor investigation in progress.
Heavy rainfall overwhelmed sediment controls; CGP corrective action notice expected.
Artifact discovered during civil works; tribal monitor consultation paused work in affected area.
Initial capacity test PR below contractual threshold by {pct}%; soiling and string-level diagnostics underway.

typical_co_drivers: Owner-directed module technology change (bifacial / larger format)
BESS scope addition or capacity increase post-NTP
Differing subsurface conditions requiring pre-drill or ballasted foundations
Interconnection facility scope additions from utility
